fact: ONACC, the national climate observatory, carried out a 2023 geomatics study using satellite analysis, SPI/SPEI and field observations to map flood and agronomic drought risk in seven Far North localities, and lists Sentinel and MODIS NDVI/VCI products for vegetation and drought monitoring.
title: Données, modélisation & géomatique - ONACC
publisher: Observatoire National sur les Changements Climatiques (ONACC)
